title: Make a working clock
desc: You already have a <div id='working-clock'></div> in the template. Use setInterval() to update that element every second with the current time.

title: Challenge 1: for loop (counting loop)
desc: You already have <div id='loopForResult'></div> in the template. Use a for loop to count from 1 to 5, store the numbers in a string, and display the result in that div.

title: Challenge 2: while loop (conditional loop)
desc: You already have <div id='loopWhileResult'></div> in the template. Start with let num = 1; and use a while loop to double the number until it becomes greater than 100. Output the final value to the div.

title: Challenge 3: do...while loop (run at least once)
desc: You already have <div id='loopDoWhileResult'></div> in the template. Start with let total = 0 and let i = 1. Use a do...while loop to keep adding i to total until total is at least 10. Output the final total to the div.

title: Challenge 4: for...of loop (loop through arrays)
desc: You already have <div id='loopForOfResult'></div> in the template. Use the array const fruits = ['Apple', 'Banana', 'Cherry']; and a for...of loop to display each fruit in the result div.

title: Challenge 5: for...in loop (loop through object keys)
desc: You already have <div id='loopForInResult'></div> in the template. Use the object const person = { name: 'Alex', age: 25, city: 'Miami' } and a for...in loop to display all the keys in the result div.
